programme.desc: Secondary school teacher Lam Yiu-kwok is suffering from a mid-life crisis - his peers have all become more successful than him; his relationship with his wife, Chan Man-ching, is in trouble when her old flame returns, and he finds himself tempted by a 17-year-old student who has a crush on him..

programme.title: 喋血雙雄
programme.desc: Jeffery is a hired killer who blinds a singer Jennie during his last job. Feeling guilty, he picks a contract to kill a head of a drug syndicate to pay for her eye operation..

programme.title: 慈禧秘密生活
programme.desc: The last empress of China, CHI HEI, had dominated the country for over fifty years. Yet, her rise to power owned much to her manipulation of her beauty and sexual appeal. Prior to becoming one of the three thousand concubines chosen to serve the emperor. CHI met KUNG, younger brother of the Emperor; and they fell in love with each other. However, KUNG fled from the relationship to avoid conflicts with his brother. In order to stand out from other concubines, CHI racked her brains to design numerous creative and exciting “on-bed tricks” for the Emperor, who madly enjoyed their lovemaking. After she bore him a son, she became the first lady..

programme.title: 生死線
programme.desc: The story takes place on a deserted island. The only residence on the island is a family in which the mother ruled over three of her sons: Tai Fat, gloomy and sullen; Yee Fat, vulgar and cruel; Sam Fat, slightly retarded. Mother's earnest wish is to find a wife for Sam Fat to continue the family tree. Teacher Cheung, along with six of his students arrive on the island for camping. They first meet Yee Fat who brings them to the grocery for a rest. Yee Fat is delighted with the presence of the 3 young girls while Sam Fat falls in love at first sight with the charming girl Phyllis. He expresses his feelings to Tai Fat who has sworn to his mother that he will fulfill her wish to find his youngest brother a wife. He proposes to Cheung that Phyllis be married to Sam Fat. Cheung first thinks that it's a joke, but soon senses that Tai Fat is serious and that all three brothers are actually psychologically imbalanced..

programme.desc: Sam and Crab are a pair of skilled gamblers. When Sam chooses to leave the life, Crab engages the vengeful attention of Yakuza. The gangsters strike back by kidnapping Sam's girl..

programme.title: 至尊無上之永霸天下
programme.desc: Though persuaded by his brother, Chicken Wing, Kit refused to gamble again. However, Tommy keeps on harassing them, Kit finally decided to take revenge..

When Fatty hit rock bottom, the ghost of his grandfather resurrected to help him. Later, Fatty learnt that his grandfather was murdered. Therefore, he would stop at nothing to avenge his death..

Hired to track down the runaway daughter of a publishing tycoon, Ryo ends up on a luxury cruise ship hijacked by terrorists. Chinese-American college student Wan Ho follows her all the way to Hong Kong to get close to her. But Jane is so popular in school and is used to having boys around her. One of them is Tse Tin, the son of the school director. While Tse Tin and Wan Ho regard each other as rivals and fight over Jane all the time, Jane has developed a crush on the P.E. teacher! Meanwhile, Pak Yat Moon has a crush on Wan Ho, and Ka Ming has crush on Pak Yat Moon! It is a total mess and the relationships become utterly chaotic! Kong's childhood friend, Anna who is betrothed to a man by her politically ambitions father. The trio decides to make a run for the boat but on the day of their planned escape, the war breaks out and they are forced to stay behind. Fai signs up to work for the enemy to help Kong and Anna in their next attempt to escape..

Based on this clue, the police thinks that it is the work of the infamous international thief 'White Glove'. Interpol is contacted and an ace detective, Baldy, is sent from New York to investigate. He is assisted by a local woman inspector known for her toughness. They start on a wrong footing initially but grow to be very fond of one another..

In one of these nights out in town, Ricky is suddenly attacked by an upset stomach. In no time, a quack doctor diagnoses the seizure as terminal cancer. Ricky seriously considers suicide. But he is also appalled by the drawbacks inherent in the many methods of doing himself in primarily the pain. It is on a rooftop from which he is supposed to make a plunge that he saves a poor man from suicide by giving the latter all the money he has. In gratitude, the newly rich man promises to hire a killer to finish off his suffering benefactor..

However, he's threatened by the underworld people and loses his job. At the same time, Siu Chun suicides after she realizes that she is being used by his boyfriend. Realizing these two facts, Chu determines to make good use of the law.

A female impersonator, Yee Tai, rebuffs the amorous advances of one of Leong's friends. Leong comes to even the score, only to be defeated soundly by Yee Tai. Realizing that he is after all not good in kung fu, Leong stays behind with Yee Tai's operatic troupe as a coolie, hoping that Yee Tai would teach him the combat art some day..

Because Chu feels her relationship with Alex is in danger, she threatens Alex to marry her once they return to Hong Kong. Otherwise, she will marry Alex's cousin and go to Canada..

They are keen to make big money so they try to get racing tips from a young jockey..

programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette, take on the vast River Trent, following in the bloody footsteps of the Vikings as they invaded 9th century Britain. programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc:
Part One of a journey along the Kamilaroi Highway, from Willow Tree to Moree, in New
South Wales, taking in The Great Divide on our way to the Great Australian Outback. Magnificent
landscapes, awesome attractions, and we meet some really cool people as we make our way through
a region which traditional owners are spiritually connected to.

programme.title: Don't Drive Here 第2季
programme.desc: If the altitude doesn't get you, the traffic will! That's what Andrew Younghusband learns in the exotic South American city of La Paz, where rules of the road are optional and definitely quirky.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.title: Million Dollar House Hunters 第1季

programme.title: Dead Meat 第6季
programme.desc: Leysath rejoins his Indiana pal, Cal Ditmar, a professional trapper. During his last visit, Leysath dared Ditmar to cook a skunk. Yes, a skunk. Not to back down from a challenge, Cal shows how it's done. They also take to the woods at night in search of coyotes and other night stalkers and talk to some seasoned trappers to learn more about why they do what they do. Not for the faint of heart or weak of stomach.

programme.title: Kangaroo Mob 第1季
programme.desc:
Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

programme.title: River Hunters 第1季第4集 -Vikings - River Trent
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette, take on the vast River Trent, following in the bloody footsteps of the Vikings as they invaded 9th century Britain. In the first ever archaeological river search of key Viking sites, they’ll be hunting for relics of Chief Ivar The Boneless and the Great Heathen Army as they conquered the Anglo-Saxon Kings of England.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: Dead Meat 第6季
programme.desc: Leysath rejoins his Indiana pal, Cal Ditmar, a professional trapper. During his last visit, Leysath dared Ditmar to cook a skunk. Yes, a skunk. Not to back down from a challenge, Cal shows how it's done. They also take to the woods at night in search of coyotes and other night stalkers and talk to some seasoned trappers to learn more about why they do what they do. Not for the faint of heart or weak of stomach.

programme.title: Dead Meat 第6季
programme.desc: Scott Leysath takes a look back at the first 5 seasons of Dead Meat and features 'The Good, the Bad, and the Slimy.' The journey has been full of surprises, but they weren't all good.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Western Australia’s Murchison GeoRegion is well known for its’ ancient landscapes and\nbrilliant skies, this is the real outback. We take a journey through a region full of stories dating back to\nthe earth’s beginning, around 4½ billion years ago.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc:
Part One of a journey along the Kamilaroi Highway, from Willow Tree to Moree, in New
South Wales, taking in The Great Divide on our way to the Great Australian Outback. Magnificent
landscapes, awesome attractions, and we meet some really cool people as we make our way through
a region which traditional owners are spiritually connected to.

programme.title: River Hunters 第1季第4集 -Vikings - River Trent
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette, take on the vast River Trent, following in the bloody footsteps of the Vikings as they invaded 9th century Britain. In the first ever archaeological river search of key Viking sites, they’ll be hunting for relics of Chief Ivar The Boneless and the Great Heathen Army as they conquered the Anglo-Saxon Kings of England.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.title: Don't Drive Here 第2季
programme.desc: If the altitude doesn't get you, the traffic will! That's what Andrew Younghusband learns in the exotic South American city of La Paz, where rules of the road are optional and definitely quirky.

programme.title: Spiky Gold Hunters 第1季
programme.desc: In the season finale of Spiky Gold Hunters, Dwayne is out to fill a massive order of urchins. And there’s a bigger boat and a larger crew called in for the task at hand. However technical problems, freezing temperatures and the power of the southern ocean puts the whole operation in jeopardy.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第1季
programme.desc: Zac and Darin take a wild ride through a once toxic city and see how Brits are turning around their pollution problem with innovative ideas like living walls, urban bees and clean eating.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第1季
programme.desc: The City of Lights sparkles even brighter as Zac and Darin take in Earth’s most important resource: water. Meanwhile, a town filled with unexplained miracle cures offers the ailing a chance to heal.

Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

The Salton Sea, just a couple hours east of Los Angeles, has a creep factor of 11, and the duck hunting is like no other place he has hunted.

programme.sub-title: 第六集｜終極四強開戰！星級試鍊登場｜學生真人SHOW｜學界傳媒
programme.desc: 終極四強開戰，兩位星級嘉賓驚喜加盟，再度點燃起同學們的戰意！然而，這場「香港美食宣傳片」創作絕非想像中順利──有隊伍主創臨陣缺席陷入孤軍作戰、亦有隊伍深陷無限NG的絕望輪迴，要對付來回地獄又折返人間的星級試鍊，同學們能否守得住初心，及時化解纏身厄運？. 想睇更多：https://www.rthk.hk/tv/dtt31/programme/mediaeds3. 逢星期二｜晚上九點半｜港台電視31. 立即下載「香港電台隨身版(RTHK On The Go)」緊貼最新節目： https://rthk.hk/otg. 記得LIKE + 訂閱 + 推播通知. #傳媒初體驗 #傳媒 #校園真人SHOW #港台實習.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群 第二季
programme.sub-title: 第十集：燕府小學運動會
programme.desc: 由於房東的挑剔，曉薇終於爆發，要退租，還要把房東的無理取鬧全部曝光到網上。房東終於服軟，答應不再過度干涉。燕府小學運動會與第二次業主大會都即將開始。果寧本來想和嘉彧好好較量一下，卻遭遇其他班「勁敵」的威脅.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 獨立發展的JW王灝兒今年火速推出兩首新作品，效率驚人。毅然走出舒適圈，她如何適應新的角色？今集《港樂．講樂》JW 除了演唱新歌，更會分享成為獨立歌手的心路歷程。. 主持. 崔潔彤. 林智樂. 歌曲：. 《你離開之後》. 《Not Your Fault.

programme.title: 國寶時刻 – 精裝版
programme.sub-title: 第十一集 仙道佛門・歷朝演繹
programme.desc: 東漢末年之後，中國經歷近三百年的分裂動盪，社會對精神信仰的追求愈發強烈，佛教大規模漢化，道教亦進一步發展成形。本集三件文物——三國吳青瓷釉下彩羽人紋盤口壺、北魏司馬金龍墓石雕棺床、山西平順龍門寺——帶領我們穿梭三國至明清的宗教藝術演變。青瓷壺上的羽人紋反映中國早期神仙信仰，肩部貼塑的佛像則見證佛教已傳播至江南；司馬金龍墓石雕棺床呈現北魏兼容並包的時代精神——力士受犍陀羅風格影響，忍冬紋源自希臘，堪稱當時的全球化設計；龍門寺集歷代建築於一身，是佛教在中國持續本土化的活見證.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 人類足跡
programme.desc: 我們內心潛藏著一個殺手，我們的祖先在演化成為人類之前就已經狩獵。狩獵不僅是為了維生，更是我們根深蒂固的文化。隨著人口增長和科技蓬勃發展，現代人類已成為世界上最高效、無處不在的超級捕食者。 為了解人類狩獵的原因，尚恩拜訪了生物學家兼獵人懷恩・朗。當尚恩跟懷恩在其愛達荷州的家中一起屠宰懷恩狩獵回來的鹿時，尚恩發現了他以往並不知道的人類與食物的聯繫。在切薩皮克灣，鴨子獵人霖斯・羅素向尚恩展示了繁榮市場和一場可稱為「軍備競賽」的獵鴨槍械發展，如何幾乎結束了壯觀的野生動物奇觀，並催生了新的狩獵監管法律。當人類把殺戮能力帶到公海，鯨魚被推向絕種邊緣，並在過程改變海洋的化學成分。尚恩的研究顯示，人類為獲取象牙獵捕大象，因而創造出無牙雌性大象族群，改變了大象的演化。最後，即使人類努力消滅其他超級掠食者，例如美國西部的土狼，我們發現人類始終無法取代生態系統中的野生掠食者。 狩獵一直是人類故事的一部分，相信未來也會繼續如此。我們與舊石器時代的祖先之間的不同之處在於，現在我們知道自己有能力做到甚麼。掌握這種知識後，我們可以更深思熟慮地使用自己的本能，給野生掠食者留出生存空間，並為「超級掠食者」的稱號賦予新意義。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年4月14日 星期一 晚上10時30分 There’s a killer inside us – our ancestors were hunters before they were even humans. And hunting isn’t just subsistence – it’s deeply ingrained in our culture. As our population has grown and our technologies flourished, modern humans have become the most efficient and ubiquitous hunters the world has ever known: the planet’s new Top Predator. To understand why we hunt, Shane visits biologist and hunter Ryan Long. Butchering a deer at Ryan’s home in Idaho, Shane rediscovers a connection to his food that he didn’t know he was missing. In the Chesapeake Bay, duck hunter Ramsey Russell shows Shane how a thriving market and a literal arms race nearly ended an epic wildlife spectacle, spurring new laws to regulate hunting. We’ve brought our killing prowess to the high seas, driving whales to the brink of extinction – and altering the ocean’s chemistry along the way. Shane’s own research shows that we’re changing the course of evolution by targeting elephants for their ivory and creating populations where tuskless females are commonplace. Finally, by waging war on other top predators, like wolves in the American West, we’re discovering that humans can’t replace wild killers in our ecosystems. Hunting has always been part of our story, and it probably always will be. The difference between us and our Paleolithic ancestors is that now we know what we’re capable of. Armed with that knowledge, we can channel our instincts more thoughtfully, leave room for wild hunters, and give new meaning to the title “Top Predator.” Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.04.14 MON 10:30pm.

programme.title: 傳媒初體驗 第三季
programme.sub-title: 第六集｜終極四強開戰！星級試鍊登場｜學生真人SHOW｜學界傳媒
programme.desc: 終極四強開戰，兩位星級嘉賓驚喜加盟，再度點燃起同學們的戰意！然而，這場「香港美食宣傳片」創作絕非想像中順利──有隊伍主創臨陣缺席陷入孤軍作戰、亦有隊伍深陷無限NG的絕望輪迴，要對付來回地獄又折返人間的星級試鍊，同學們能否守得住初心，及時化解纏身厄運？. 想睇更多：https://www.rthk.hk/tv/dtt31/programme/mediaeds3. 逢星期二｜晚上九點半｜港台電視31. 立即下載「香港電台隨身版(RTHK On The Go)」緊貼最新節目： https://rthk.hk/otg. 記得LIKE + 訂閱 + 推播通知. #傳媒初體驗 #傳媒 #校園真人SHOW #港台實習.

programme.title: 好玩科學
programme.desc: 今集，小朋友將探索幻視轉盤及定格動畫如何運用「視覺暫留」原理。我們會利用「強迫透視」錯覺打造電影特效、測試膝躍反射，並拆解人類演化出對生拇指的原因。此外，還會挑戰步數邏輯謎題，並見證鎳鈦諾合金的形狀記憶特性。「未來科技」則介紹能協助殘疾人士重獲行動力的外骨骼技術，並探討未來量子計算如何實現更強大的運算能力。. The kids explore how forms of animation including thaumatropes and stop motion, use persistence of vision. We create movie effects with the illusion of forced perspective; activate the patellar reflex; discover why humans have evolved opposable thumbs; solve a steps-based logic puzzle and marvel at the shape memory of a metal alloy called Nitinol. Fun future facts check out the development of exoskeletons, that may assist disabled people to regain movement. And we discover how the future of computing might be carried out on a quantum level, allowing for much greater computing power.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
學人沙龍
programme.desc: 林則徐銷煙是道德與經濟的考量。本集將重返十九世紀，剖析鴉片貿易如何顛覆中國「世界工廠」的黃金時代，引發白銀外流的經濟危機。從經濟理性視角，解讀林則徐為何必須採取「嚴禁」手段，並探討虎門銷煙這一歷史性抉擇，如何成為中國從貿易順差國，轉變為全球「傾銷市場」的關鍵轉捩點。. 主持:. 譚家齊(香港浸會大學歷史系副教授). 曾卓然(嶺南大學中文系哲學博士). 陳芳芳(香港浸會大學歷史系助理教授). 徐頌雯(嶺南大學歷史系副教授).

programme.title: 31看世界 - 鬥快去北美
programme.desc: 隨著其一中隊參賽隊伍在第三個賽段被淘汰，餘下的四隊正前往第四個中途站邱吉爾。邱吉爾靠近北極邊緣的赫德森海灣，是一個北極熊數量比人還要多的城市。除了一星期兩班的火車外，並沒有其他交通工具或公路把邱吉爾與加拿大其他地區連接起來，而各隊只有三天的時間趕上火車。這段旅程會引領參賽隊伍由艾伯塔省的主要城市卡加利和愛民頓，穿越分隔洛基山脈和薩斯喀徹溫省的廣闊草原和荒地。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年11月5日 星期二晚上10時30分.

programme.title: 灣區全媒睇
programme.desc: #灣區全媒睇第一千二百六十二集. 主持. 鄭萃雯、涂冠祺. 南北快閃. 蘇州：首批內河集貨櫃電動船投運. 珠海：珠琴澳食安宣傳周啟動. 澳門：澳高校橫琴產學研平台賦能產業發展. 無錫：認養一棵古樹守護一部綠色史書. 江門：感悟陳白沙筆下的江門風物. 廣為人知. 廣州：《白雲文化研究叢書》新書首發. 廣州：南沙首屆萌寵嘉年華開幕. 廣州：汽車文化公園對外開放釋放城市綠地綜合價值. 灣區新里程. 武漢：空心村落蛻變網紅微度假地. 福州：活化工業「舊」場景煥發文旅「新」生機. 哈爾濱：江畔熒光跑出文旅新「夜」態. 鳥瞰神州. 渭南：黛色染盡清風自來.

programme.title: 非凡人物
programme.desc: 人類為何會貪新鮮？貪新忘舊似乎貫穿古今中外：古代有白居易筆下的「三嫌老醜換蛾眉」，國外亦有「籬笆另一邊的草總是更綠」。究竟貪新有錯嗎？新與舊能否共存？本集主持和人文學講座教授文潔華一起探討。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 梁重皿(臨床心理學家). 葉德平(大學講師). 嘉賓主持：. 文潔華(人文學講座教授). #人性#貪念#新舊#慾望#哲學.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 周遊列車- 再出發
programme.sub-title: 周遊列車 再出發 - 巴西
programme.desc: 菲臘登上里約熱內盧一列原創味十足的通勤火車。乘客在火車上能買到很多商品，還有一位駐火車按摩師為乘客按摩。他又坐上世界上最長的火車，穿過里約熱內盧東北部及部分亞馬遜雨林。這片森林生物多樣性豐富，森林中人還保留著獨特的儀式。例如薩特雷-馬韋族落年輕人的成年禮，讓毒蟻叮咬雙手。菲臘見識過這些儀式後，前往南部的坎普斯-杜若爾當。巴西人無需離開國家，在這裏就能享受歐陸風情。菲臘再前往大西洋沿岸，在那裏登上一艘軌道風帆，感受純風力驅動的航行，為旅程畫上完美句號。 The journey begins in Rio de Janeiro, where he travels on a highly original commuter train. It sells everything, and even has a masseur offering his services directly in the carriages. Philippe then took the world's largest train, which travelled through the north-east of the country and crossed part of the Amazon rainforest. A forest rich in biodiversity and also in unusual rituals. Like the rite of passage to adulthood for the young members of the Satere-Mawe tribe: they have to have their hands stung by poisonous ants. After this encounter, we head south to Campo De Jordao, where the Brazilians can discover a piece of Europe without leaving their country. To round off the trip, the Brazilians head for the Atlantic coast, where a sail-powered tugboat will take Philippe on a journey powered only by the wind.

programme.title: 非凡人物
programme.desc: 香港管弦樂團第一副首席梁建楓，由5歲開始習琴，他的一生都被古典音樂圍繞。致力推動音樂教育的梁建楓，擔任多個樂團的藝術總監，並創立青年樂團，為年輕樂手提供訓練與演出機會。作為香港古典音樂發展的標誌性人物，梁建楓如何帶領年輕一代走進古典樂的世界？. 主持：. 米哈(作者). 曾奕文(音樂學院副教授). 嘉賓：. 梁建楓(香港藝術發展局音樂組別主席). #古典音樂#小提琴#港樂#管弦樂#指揮.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 周遊列車- 再出發
programme.sub-title: 周遊列車 再出發 - 巴西
programme.desc: 菲臘登上里約熱內盧一列原創味十足的通勤火車。乘客在火車上能買到很多商品，還有一位駐火車按摩師為乘客按摩。他又坐上世界上最長的火車，穿過里約熱內盧東北部及部分亞馬遜雨林。這片森林生物多樣性豐富，森林中人還保留著獨特的儀式。例如薩特雷-馬韋族落年輕人的成年禮，讓毒蟻叮咬雙手。菲臘見識過這些儀式後，前往南部的坎普斯-杜若爾當。巴西人無需離開國家，在這裏就能享受歐陸風情。菲臘再前往大西洋沿岸，在那裏登上一艘軌道風帆，感受純風力驅動的航行，為旅程畫上完美句號。 The journey begins in Rio de Janeiro, where he travels on a highly original commuter train. It sells everything, and even has a masseur offering his services directly in the carriages. Philippe then took the world's largest train, which travelled through the north-east of the country and crossed part of the Amazon rainforest. A forest rich in biodiversity and also in unusual rituals. Like the rite of passage to adulthood for the young members of the Satere-Mawe tribe: they have to have their hands stung by poisonous ants. After this encounter, we head south to Campo De Jordao, where the Brazilians can discover a piece of Europe without leaving their country. To round off the trip, the Brazilians head for the Atlantic coast, where a sail-powered tugboat will take Philippe on a journey powered only by the wind.

programme.title: 典故裏的科學 第二季
programme.desc: 「身輕如燕」的「燕」是漢成帝的傳奇皇后—趙飛燕。相傳，趙飛燕曾在跳舞時，險些被風吹倒。侍郎馮無方扔掉手中的笙，飛身托起趙飛燕，飛燕在托舉之下繼續從容舞蹈。這便是「身輕如燕」的典故。那麼，「身輕如燕」到底是一種甚麼狀態？科學求證人高澤民將一探究竟.

programme.title: 典故裏的科學 第二季
programme.desc: 遠遊對於現代人來說常見，但是在古代卻不一樣。《韓非子·說林上》中這樣寫道：「春往冬返，迷惑失道。管仲曰：老馬之智可用也。乃放老馬而隨之，遂得道。」這便是「老馬識途」的典故。老馬真的能够識途？科學求證人高澤民帶着疑問來到了雲南省大理市鳳陽邑村一探究竟.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.sub-title: It turns out I have ADHD
programme.desc: Childhood hyperactivity—often described colloquially as “big‑headed shrimp, never stopping”—is very common. When these behaviors persist into adulthood, there is a chance of having ADHD (Attention‑Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder). A university estimate suggests that 2.5 % of Hong Kong’s adult population may have the condition, yet data from the Hospital Authority show that fewer than 4,000 adults have been diagnosed and are receiving treatment. How can one determine whether they have ADHD? Is this behavioral disorder hereditary? In this episode we will invite adult ADHD patients to share their experiences, and the medical team will explain the latest diagnostic and treatment approaches.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
香港故事 ---近水留情
programme.desc: The 400-year-old Shui Hau Village is so inseparable with water that “Shui Hau” means “the outlet of a river”. Nestled between mountains and rivers, Shui Hau Village is surrounded by hills, mudflats and wetland. Villagers used to make a living by farming until the 1970s, when many of them were dragged away from agriculture by the urbanisation of Hong Kong, and since then the farmland gradually became wetland. The wetland has been abandoned for years, but re-cultivation has been carried out in recent years to conserve the topography and biodiversity of Shui Hau. Although the group of young people do not have much experience in farming, driven by their passion for conservation, they reclaim the farmland manually from ground zero in hopes of creating a sustainable environment. The villagers are delighted with the changes, as most of them were born and raised here, feeling deeply connected with the Village. Some of them have moved to the city, but they still have fond memories on the village life, so they return and actively promote ecological and cultural activities for the Village, hoping to raise public awareness of the historical value of the Village.

programme.title: 不完美受害人
programme.sub-title: 第十二集: 趙尋再次被質疑
programme.desc: 林闞第二次提交證據和律師辯護意見，拿出趙尋對成功親口否認強姦的視頻。上司質疑趙尋人品，要求停止偵查，但晏明決定與趙尋走到底。林闞着眼匿名報警人，尋找失蹤的尹聲.

programme.title: 不完美受害人
programme.sub-title: 第十三集: 尋找匿名報警人
programme.desc: 尹聲的前女友米芒，曾被現任丈夫包力強姦，尹聲因而毆打包力。林闞由此捕捉到尹聲的報警原因。陳默被釋放，趙尋陪他一起回家，向陳默父母坦誠自己是成功強姦案女當事人，親口解釋陳默打架是替她打抱不平。陳默父母對她不畏強權、勇敢說不的行為大加讚賞.

programme.title: 非凡人物
programme.desc: 70年代末至80年代初，一群受過西方電影教育、從電視台累積實戰經驗的年輕導演，憑藉銳利的鏡頭語言與對在地社會現實的關懷，掀起了一場徹底改變香港電影命脈的「香港電影新浪潮」。勇於嘗試、力求創新、無懼低成本仍然堅持自我風格，本集請來新浪潮電影始祖章國明導演暢談這股新浪潮精神。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 馮榕榕(策展人). 黃梓勇(大學講師). 嘉賓主持：. 章國明(導演). . #電影#導演#編劇#新浪潮#影視#章國明.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
31看世界 - 周遊列車- 再出發
programme.sub-title: 周遊列車 再出發 - 烏拉圭
programme.desc: 南美小國烏拉圭，位處巴西和阿根廷兩個大國之間，擁有輝煌鐵路歷史。如今烏拉圭只餘下一班色彩繽紛的客運列車，往返利維拉與塔誇倫博，深受彭巴草原居民的喜愛。菲臘和南美牛仔高卓人見面，他們精通馬術，也在農田耕作。他吃過地道的美味燒烤「阿薩多」後前往派桑杜，那裡有一輛以1929 年福特老爺車改造而成的火車頭，是給員工使用的鐵道巡檢車。菲臘又前去大西洋沿岸及烏拉圭首都蒙特維多，那裡有一列火車，一年內只為一群鐵路發燒友行駛幾次。 Wedged between its two big neighbours, Brazil and Argentina, Uruguay is a small South American country with a great railway history. But it now has just one passenger train, which runs from Rivera to Tacuarembó. It's a colourful train, much loved by the inhabitants of the pampas. This journey takes Philippe to the gauchos, the South American cowboys who practice rodeo and work in the fields. After a good 'asado', the local barbecue, the railway globetrotter heads for Paysandú, where an old 1929 Ford car has been adapted into a train, a sort of draisine for the employees. Then it's on to the Atlantic coast and its capital, Montevideo, where, for a few days each year, a train runs purely for the pleasure of a group of railway enthusiasts.

programme.title: 國寶時刻 – 精裝版
programme.sub-title: 第十一集 仙道佛門・歷朝演繹
programme.desc: 東漢末年之後，中國經歷近三百年的分裂動盪，社會對精神信仰的追求愈發強烈，佛教大規模漢化，道教亦進一步發展成形。本集三件文物——三國吳青瓷釉下彩羽人紋盤口壺、北魏司馬金龍墓石雕棺床、山西平順龍門寺——帶領我們穿梭三國至明清的宗教藝術演變。青瓷壺上的羽人紋反映中國早期神仙信仰，肩部貼塑的佛像則見證佛教已傳播至江南；司馬金龍墓石雕棺床呈現北魏兼容並包的時代精神——力士受犍陀羅風格影響，忍冬紋源自希臘，堪稱當時的全球化設計；龍門寺集歷代建築於一身，是佛教在中國持續本土化的活見證.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 獨立發展的JW王灝兒今年火速推出兩首新作品，效率驚人。毅然走出舒適圈，她如何適應新的角色？今集《港樂．講樂》JW 除了演唱新歌，更會分享成為獨立歌手的心路歷程。. 主持. 崔潔彤. 林智樂. 歌曲：. 《你離開之後》. 《Not Your Fault.

programme.title: 亞太廣播聯盟機械人大賽2026
programme.desc: 第23屆「全港大專生機械人大賽」（Robocon HK），迎來九間大專院校、合共十五支隊伍同場競技。距離比賽不足兩星期，各隊形勢未見明朗。. . 香港教育大學第七年參賽，今年有前任香港大學隊員Henry轉投成為導師；闊別一年再戰的嶺南大學，則由歷任隊長Anthony帶隊。兩校亦敵亦友，都沒有工程學院，資源有限，靠「用愛發電」最終能夠走得多遠？. 另一邊廂，首屈一指的香港大學和香港中文大學各有風波。港大「明德」進度落後；中大「巧奪天工」遲遲未穩。兩隊作為冠軍大熱，在時間緊逼下如何能穩住陣腳.

programme.title: 太陽小記者- 2026西域記
programme.sub-title: 開發新疆 融入國家發展
programme.desc: 新疆得到國家的大力支持，在政治、經濟、文化等各方面高質量發展，積極融入國家發展大局。遼闊無垠的新疆大地，陽光和風沙孕育出獨特而豐盛的生命力。雪水滋養綠洲，成就了一片片生機盎然的農田。從先輩們披荊斬棘、開墾荒原，新疆用汗水與智慧，寫出一段跨越時代的耕耘故事。太陽使者親身來到這片大土，品嚐蟠桃、到訪棉田、葡萄園，用五感去體驗這片土地帶來的溫度。主持人阮頌陽再次重遊舊地，跟一班太陽使者到達石河子大學觀賞林則徐電影，在同一片土地上感受林則徐的堅毅與愛國精神。. 主持：阮頌陽嚴崇天. *************************************************************************. 太陽計劃2026由香港電台、香港中華文化發展聯合會主辦，保華基金會贊助，並獲民青局青年內地交流資助計劃資助。（本宣傳品僅代表主辦機構之立場.

programme.title: 周末大電影：奇蹟
programme.desc: 郭振華(成龍飾)孑身到香港找工作，卻被董大千(董驃飾)騙去所有財物。後來郭於街上遇到好心的賣花婦玫瑰夫人(歸亞蕾飾)，並向她買了一枝幸運玫瑰。不久，郭即誤打誤撞成為了黑幫老大，並認識了歌女楊露明(梅艷芳飾)，與她墮入愛河。因此，郭堅信是夫人的玫瑰為他帶來好運。後來露明得悉夫人女兒與富有未婚夫及其父來港洽談婚事，決定和郭合力助夫人隱瞞窮困身份，並召集各路黑幫頭子假冒官紳，籌備一場盛大的訂婚宴，奈何遭何探長(吳耀漢飾)誤以為黑幫集會，予以圍剿。正當各人感到絕望之時，郭卻奇蹟地感動了城中官紳、名流出席盛宴，場面溫馨感人.

programme.title: 香港故事 ---近水留情
programme.desc: The 400-year-old Shui Hau Village is so inseparable with water that “Shui Hau” means “the outlet of a river”. Nestled between mountains and rivers, Shui Hau Village is surrounded by hills, mudflats and wetland. Villagers used to make a living by farming until the 1970s, when many of them were dragged away from agriculture by the urbanisation of Hong Kong, and since then the farmland gradually became wetland. The wetland has been abandoned for years, but re-cultivation has been carried out in recent years to conserve the topography and biodiversity of Shui Hau. Although the group of young people do not have much experience in farming, driven by their passion for conservation, they reclaim the farmland manually from ground zero in hopes of creating a sustainable environment. The villagers are delighted with the changes, as most of them were born and raised here, feeling deeply connected with the Village. Some of them have moved to the city, but they still have fond memories on the village life, so they return and actively promote ecological and cultural activities for the Village, hoping to raise public awareness of the historical value of the Village.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 四隻海鸚發現利奧和貝莎擁有一隻海鸚蛋。由於擔心這兩隻水獺會想吃掉那隻蛋，牠們決定偷走海鸚蛋並帶到神秘的尊尼那裏，尋求幫助。海鸚們能成功救回這顆蛋嗎.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 風暴肆虐，海鸚們聚集在俱樂部會所，準備度過一個恐怖電影之夜。迪迪還對同伴們開了幾個可怕的惡作劇，但最終誰能笑到最後呢.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 在玩瓶子旋轉遊戲時，佩佩因為太害羞而拒絕親德仔的臉頰。看到這一幕，尊尼決定為四隻海鸚講述《白雪海鸚》的故事。這會改變一切嗎.

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 本集中的速度動物寶寶目前尚未達到最高速度，但牠們具備成為地球上最快生物的潛能。小馬駒能夠疾速奔馳，獵豹BB將達到時速約120公里，遊隼雛鳥更將成長為全球最快的鳥類。本集呈現這些非凡動物BB及其對極致速度的天賦需求.

programme.title: 追夢者
programme.sub-title: Dr. Pui-wah Choi: The Science of Happiness
programme.desc: "I found my own path to happiness through science. How about you? You too can find your own path, your own way to make a difference in the world.". - Dr. Pui-wah Choi. Dr. Choi, a holder of a PhD from the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) and the founder of a Biotech company, is an accomplished female biomedical scientist with a profound interest in addressing women's diseases. Her doctoral research primarily focused on ovarian cyst formation and the migration of ovarian cancer cells. She pursued postdoctoral training at Harvard Medical School in Boston, MA. This included the discovery of new biomarkers for diagnosing and prognosing ovarian cancer. . Through her groundbreaking work, she has made significant contributions to the field by inventing a non-invasive kit that combines a sanitary pad for self-testing for cervical cancer. The journey of scientific invention bears a striking resemblance to that of Monk Tong, who obtained the sutra. Along the path to the east, obstacles abound. As a female scientist, Dr. Choi will share her personal experience and insights on overcoming challenges while striving to enhance human health and well-being. Her ultimate goal is to fulfill the dreams of others, enabling them to lead healthy and happy lives.

programme.title: 鄉郊豐年節2026：香港山水 · 聲舞 一日音樂節
programme.sub-title: 客家音聊 & 港茶/武俠情·空心樹
programme.desc: 本集聚焦嶺南鄉郊文化與經典武俠情懷，於荔枝窩展開一場跨越世代與地域的聲音對話。節目分為兩部分：第一部分「客家音聊&港茶」，由百歲客家村民黃強英與音樂大師譚盾展開跨世代對談，並在青年演奏家張夢的笙與劉雯雯的嗩吶合奏下，清唱《十月懷胎》等多首傳統山歌，古樸嗓音與現代樂器碰撞出獨特的文化韻味；第二部分「武俠情·空心樹」則移師荔枝窩百年空心樹下，由深港澳三重奏傾力演奏譚盾為經典電影《夜宴》、《臥虎藏龍》、《英雄》及《復活》創作的配樂奏鳴曲，讓熾熱的武俠情懷在古樹山水之間獲得現代新生。. 音樂節片段由環境及生態局鄉郊保育辦公室攝製及提供。. 曲目. 第一部分：客家音聊&港茶. 客家山歌（多首）：黃強英. 笙：張夢. 嗩吶：劉雯雯. 第二部分：武俠情·空心樹. . 《夜宴》鋼琴奏鳴曲：黃蔚然. 《臥虎藏龍》大提琴與鋼琴奏鳴曲：聶佳鵬、黃蔚然 . 《英雄》小提琴與鋼琴奏鳴曲：王倩兒、黃蔚然. 《復活》小提琴、大提琴、鋼琴三重奏鳴曲：王倩兒、聶佳鵬、黃蔚然.

programme.title: 香港同胞慶祝中華人民共和國成立七十七周年文藝晚會
夢想中華人物誌 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 李兆基博士憑著非凡的智慧與商業眼光，成功創立以地產為核心的企業。李博士以「聚散之道」管理財富，秉持「搵錢要成功，使錢要成功」的理念，致力回饋社會與國家：興建醫院、捐助學校、設立獎學金，為市民與青年提供機會；同時，他亦放眼神州，透過培華教育基金，長年為國家培育專業人才，影響遍及中華大地，他的付出化成希望，並以生生不息的傳承精神延續下去。. 受訪者包括：. 李敬恩（李兆基外孫女）. 李徐子淇（李兆基媳婦）. 李業廣（前香港公開大學校董會主席、港交所前任主席）. 王䓪鳴（香港青年協會高級顧問）. 李繼堯（仁安醫院院長及醫務總監）. 胡經昌（香港培華教育基金會常務委員會委員及公關組主任）. 李鴻斌（「牛津大學李兆基獎學金」得主.

programme.desc: 黃劍文(Kimman)年青時曾遊走世界不同地方演唱，亦參加過多個選秀節目，最深刻的體會，就是音樂療癒的能力。今集除了帶來新歌《默默》，Kimman還會娓娓道來音樂帶給他的力量。. 主持. 李志剛、周卓盈. 歌曲：. 《遠走》. 《默默.

programme.title: 國寶時刻 – 精裝版
programme.sub-title: 第十二集 金碧璀璨・映照盛唐
programme.desc: 唐代是中華文明光輝燦爛的盛世，絲綢之路的繁榮讓中原得以吸收西域、中亞乃至西亞的文明精粹，成就了金碧璀璨的物質文化。本集三件文物——北齊白釉綠彩三系罐、唐代八曲葵花形螺鈿銅鏡、唐代鑲金獸首瑪瑙杯——正是盛唐氣象的最佳見證。白釉綠彩三系罐的工藝與美學直接影響唐三彩，預告一個開放繁榮時代的來臨；螺鈿銅鏡將貝殼鑲嵌工藝應用於銅器之上，是唐代工藝巔峰的代表，更影響日本正倉院的頂級收藏；鑲金獸首瑪瑙杯的器型可追溯至四千年前愛琴海地區的角形酒杯Rhyton，橫跨歐亞大陸，見證絲路東西文明的深度交融.

programme.title: 海市蜃樓
programme.sub-title: 第四集：蜃景又回到湖中
programme.desc: 曹晟等人往蜃樓前行，發現它竟是可移動和飛行的實體城池。他們決定返回登州查探究竟，但途中遭遇各種障礙。當他們正在想着用火炮攻擊蜃樓的方法時，蜃樓再次回到湖中，他們想進城不果，決定在湖床挖掘地道至城池下方。然而突然，他們遭到一群黑衣人伏擊，雙方決戰.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.sub-title: It turns out I have ADHD
programme.desc: Childhood hyperactivity—often described colloquially as “big‑headed shrimp, never stopping”—is very common. When these behaviors persist into adulthood, there is a chance of having ADHD (Attention‑Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder). A university estimate suggests that 2.5 % of Hong Kong’s adult population may have the condition, yet data from the Hospital Authority show that fewer than 4,000 adults have been diagnosed and are receiving treatment. How can one determine whether they have ADHD? Is this behavioral disorder hereditary? In this episode we will invite adult ADHD patients to share their experiences, and the medical team will explain the latest diagnostic and treatment approaches.

programme.title: 追夢者
programme.sub-title: Dr. Pui-wah Choi: The Science of Happiness
programme.desc: "I found my own path to happiness through science. How about you? You too can find your own path, your own way to make a difference in the world.". - Dr. Pui-wah Choi. Dr. Choi, a holder of a PhD from the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) and the founder of a Biotech company, is an accomplished female biomedical scientist with a profound interest in addressing women's diseases. Her doctoral research primarily focused on ovarian cyst formation and the migration of ovarian cancer cells. She pursued postdoctoral training at Harvard Medical School in Boston, MA. This included the discovery of new biomarkers for diagnosing and prognosing ovarian cancer. . Through her groundbreaking work, she has made significant contributions to the field by inventing a non-invasive kit that combines a sanitary pad for self-testing for cervical cancer. The journey of scientific invention bears a striking resemblance to that of Monk Tong, who obtained the sutra. Along the path to the east, obstacles abound. As a female scientist, Dr. Choi will share her personal experience and insights on overcoming challenges while striving to enhance human health and well-being. Her ultimate goal is to fulfill the dreams of others, enabling them to lead healthy and happy lives.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.sub-title: 關節裡的「玻璃針」：拆解痛風的真相
programme.desc: ​「醫生，我隻腳好痛！」. 「我唔喝酒、又唔食海鮮，點解痛風仲會發作？」. ​​痛風，曾被稱為大魚大肉者的「帝王病」，如今已走向大眾。當體內尿酸過高，結晶便會悄悄沉積於關節，引發突發性的劇烈紅腫與撕裂痛楚。現時全港約有 3%的人口深受痛風困擾；​痛風絕非單純的關節痛，若延誤診治，不僅會造成關節永久變形破壞，更常伴隨高血壓、高血脂及肥胖等代謝疾病。痛風雖無法根治，但絕對可以精準控制！本集節目將帶大家拆解痛風成因及預防方法，助您擺脫痛風折磨，重拾無痛人生。. 主持：董光達醫生、梁凱寧. 嘉賓：東區尤德夫人那打素醫院內科副部門主管李嘉麗醫生.

programme.title: 香港故事: 樂地生根
programme.desc: 二十年前，葉佳是隻身南下的上海「國援」，視香港為短暫的客場；二十年後，他在香港繼續享受足球，於香港落地生根，將客場變成主場。. 經歷過高低起跌，葉佳用汗水、用努力贏得尊重。如今他主場出擊，從球員變身教練，助攻下一代香港球員，踢出屬於他們的未來。. . #葉佳#大埔#和富社企女子足球隊#足球#女足.

programme.title: 野境求真
programme.sub-title: 第四集：觸碰溶洞上古印記
programme.desc: 戶外專家朱煒強與鬼谷藏龍，一同前往陝西寧強縣禪家岩鎮，穿越石林、天坑、溶洞尋找古生物化石，進入神秘的地底溶洞，觀察億萬年地質演變的奇蹟並探尋上古印記.

programme.title: 家·我心我城
programme.sub-title: 第二十一集：東霓激怒西決和南音
programme.desc: 大媽把東霓裝方靖暉把柄的手機丟進了洗腳盆。東霓下樓說她再也不會認大媽了。南音幫大媽說話，東霓逼問南音，南音承認文件是她拿的。東霓氣的要打她。西決忍不住說出東霓早就拿了方靖暉婚內財產的一半，可東霓還是不滿足。東霓故意嘲笑西決，江薏早就定了要去北京.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 巴黎，不僅是夢之都，更是一面映照東方想像的鏡子。今集將與您一同穿越時空，從中世紀城市規劃與中國都城的對比，到凡爾賽與紫禁城的權力對話；從周恩來等革命先驅在此點燃的理想火種，到貝聿銘用玻璃金字塔寫下的東西融合。我們將跟隨這道變換的「中國凝視」，從仰望到今日的平等對話，重新解讀這座永恆之城的故事。. 主持:. 譚家齊(香港浸會大學歷史系副教授). 曾卓然(嶺南大學中文系哲學博士). 陳芳芳(香港浸會大學歷史系助理教授). 徐頌雯(嶺南大學歷史系副教授).

programme.title: 31看世界 - 科技保育
programme.desc: 第六次大滅絕迫在眉睫，全球科學家致力於保護受威脅物種。每天約有150個物種消失，保育工作面臨時間挑戰，因此日益依賴高科技。. 普朗克動物行為研究所提出建立動物互聯網，記錄動物遷徙並創建地球生物預警系統。. 在德國，人工智能能迅速識別紅鳶和禿鷹，並在危險範圍內停止風車運轉。. 在肯尼亞，人工智能快速統計濒危動物數量，發現長頸鹿數量大幅下降。. 在法國，已絕跡於地中海的扁鯊是否真的重現在科西嘉海域？. 高科技能否成為物種保育的關鍵呢.

programme.title: 亞太廣播聯盟機械人大賽2026
programme.desc: 第23屆「全港大專生機械人大賽」（Robocon HK），迎來九間大專院校、合共十五支隊伍同場競技。距離比賽不足兩星期，各隊形勢未見明朗。. . 香港教育大學第七年參賽，今年有前任香港大學隊員Henry轉投成為導師；闊別一年再戰的嶺南大學，則由歷任隊長Anthony帶隊。兩校亦敵亦友，都沒有工程學院，資源有限，靠「用愛發電」最終能夠走得多遠？. 另一邊廂，首屈一指的香港大學和香港中文大學各有風波。港大「明德」進度落後；中大「巧奪天工」遲遲未穩。兩隊作為冠軍大熱，在時間緊逼下如何能穩住陣腳.

programme.title: 太陽小記者- 2026西域記
programme.sub-title: 開發新疆 融入國家發展
programme.desc: 新疆得到國家的大力支持，在政治、經濟、文化等各方面高質量發展，積極融入國家發展大局。遼闊無垠的新疆大地，陽光和風沙孕育出獨特而豐盛的生命力。雪水滋養綠洲，成就了一片片生機盎然的農田。從先輩們披荊斬棘、開墾荒原，新疆用汗水與智慧，寫出一段跨越時代的耕耘故事。太陽使者親身來到這片大土，品嚐蟠桃、到訪棉田、葡萄園，用五感去體驗這片土地帶來的溫度。主持人阮頌陽再次重遊舊地，跟一班太陽使者到達石河子大學觀賞林則徐電影，在同一片土地上感受林則徐的堅毅與愛國精神。. 主持：阮頌陽嚴崇天. *************************************************************************. 太陽計劃2026由香港電台、香港中華文化發展聯合會主辦，保華基金會贊助，並獲民青局青年內地交流資助計劃資助。（本宣傳品僅代表主辦機構之立場.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 科技保育
programme.desc: 第六次大滅絕迫在眉睫，全球科學家致力於保護受威脅物種。每天約有150個物種消失，保育工作面臨時間挑戰，因此日益依賴高科技。. 普朗克動物行為研究所提出建立動物互聯網，記錄動物遷徙並創建地球生物預警系統。. 在德國，人工智能能迅速識別紅鳶和禿鷹，並在危險範圍內停止風車運轉。. 在肯尼亞，人工智能快速統計濒危動物數量，發現長頸鹿數量大幅下降。. 在法國，已絕跡於地中海的扁鯊是否真的重現在科西嘉海域？. 高科技能否成為物種保育的關鍵呢.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 如果要說對香港有重大貢獻的建築師，何弢絕對是其中一位業界尊敬的建築師典範。由香港文化區到東區走廊板道，都有他的足跡；就連代表香港人的區旗區徽設計亦都有份參與其中，可見何弢對香港發展的貢獻，遠遠不止於建築。. 今集《學人沙龍》將會帶觀眾認識這位香港建築師何弢的作品和理念！. 主持：. 潘浩倫(建築師). 董正綱(建築師). 黎雋維(英國註冊建築師). 郭美珩(香港綠色建築議會董事). #學人沙龍#黎雋維#何弢#西九文化區#區旗#區徽.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 人類足跡
programme.desc: 我們稱牠們為「人類最好的朋友」，但我們之間的長久關係遠不止友誼那麼簡單。人類已經將狗的祖先狼，變成令人眼花繚亂的品種，有花枝招展的亦有異於尋常的。正如我們在狗身上留下了「人類足跡」一樣，牠們也在我們身上以及我們共同生活的世界上留下了「爪印」。 在這一集尚恩的旅程從北極圈以北開始，在那裏因紐特雪橇犬的體力和耐力，讓傳統生活方式得以`蓬勃發展。但讓狗狗成為理想盟友的不僅是因為牠們的體力，還有牠們的智力。尚恩拜訪受訓中的服務犬和表演中的精英犬隻「舞者」，觀察狗如何以其他物種無法做到的方式理解我們，正是這種能力讓第一批狗在人類的庇護下茁壯成長。尚恩在墨西哥城看倒，數億隻狗仍然以一種獨特方式生活，一種既非野生，亦非寵物的方式。另一極端是威斯敏斯特狗展的純種競賽犬。透過研究經過數個世紀選擇性繁殖的純種狗基因，研究人員發現在某些癌症範疇，狗和人有相近的遺傳成因。 我們與狗是真正的合作伙伴，這種伙伴關係已醞釀數千年。狗的確了解我們，就像所有好朋友一樣，牠們教會我們一些我們無法單獨發現的事情。牠們在街上和我們的家中繁衍，數量比狼多出三千倍，因為在人類時代，成為狗好合理。。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年4月21日 星期一 晚上10時30分 We call them Man’s Best Friend. But there’s more to our ancient alliance than friendship. Humans have transformed dogs from their wolf ancestors into a dazzling array of breeds, from beautiful to bizarre. And just as we’ve left our Human Footprint on dogs, they’ve left their pawprint on us… and the world we both share. Shane’s journey begins above the Arctic Circle, where the power and endurance of Inuit sled dogs allow a traditional way of life to thrive. But it’s not just brawn that makes dogs ideal allies – it’s brains. Shane visits service dogs in training and elite canine “dancers” in performance to see how dogs understand us in a way no other species can – an ability that allowed the first dogs to flourish in humankind’s shadow. And as Shane sees in Mexico City, hundreds of millions of dogs still live this way – not wild, but not pets either. At the other extreme are the purebred competitors of the Westminster Dog Show. By studying their DNA after centuries of selective breeding, researchers are discovering the genetic causes of cancer… in dogs and in humans. Our relationship with dogs is a true collaboration, millennia in the making. Dogs really do know us – and like all great friends, they teach us things about ourselves that we wouldn’t discover any other way. They thrive on the streets and inside our homes, outnumbering wolves three thousand to one… because in the age of humans, there’s no wrong way to be a dog. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run)2025.04.21 MON 10:30pm.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂 (英文版)
programme.desc: Two distinct travel memories to Hong Kong ended up planting the seeds of a new home for both Head Chef Balram Yadav and restaurant owner Alex P.E. . Through the masterful blending of spices, Indian cuisine accentuates a vibrant tapestry of color, aroma, and flavor—showcased in iconic dishes like butter chicken and crispy dosa—with the northern and southern regions each cultivating their own distinct culinary traditions. Deeply inspired by watching his mother cook throughout his childhood, Balram embarked on a culinary path early in life; his extensive international working experience eventually led him to realize his culinary dreams step-by-step in Hong Kong. Meanwhile, unable to bear the thought of his beloved dining haunt closing its doors after many years, Alex boldly stepped in to take over the business, dedicated to preserving and passing on its rich vegetarian culture. In this same vibrant space, both men have turned an exciting new page in their lives.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
國寶時刻
programme.desc: 祭山圖玉璋於1986年四川廣漢三星堆遺址出土，屬夏商時期禮器，由青灰色玉石製成，表面光潤並有明顯焚燒痕跡。玉璋刻有上、下兩幅對稱圖案，每幅圖案又分為五層意象，描繪站立人物、高山、雲氣、火焰、跪拜者等，體現古蜀人祭祀山川的通天信仰。此璋源於中原禮制，傳入古蜀後與本地信仰深度融合，展現古蜀文明與中原文明的交流與互鑒，是中華文明多元一體格局的生動見證.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 大克鼎為西周中晚期青銅禮器，高93厘米，重201公斤，造型雄渾莊重，與大盂鼎、毛公鼎並稱「海內三寶」。鼎腹內壁鑄有28行，共290字銘文，記載周王重申「克」之官職，命其擔任膳夫，傳達王命，並賜予政務及禮樂人員。銘文前半段追憶其祖先師華父輔佐王室之功績，後半段詳述冊命過程。大克鼎體現西周「藏禮於器」的禮制精神，是研究西周政治制度與青銅鑄造工藝的重要器物.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 《高逸圖》卷為晚唐畫家孫位唯一存世作品，以魏晉「竹林七賢」為主題，現存山濤、王戎、劉伶、阮籍四位人物，其餘三人形象之畫卷已散佚。宋徽宗曾為此卷題簽「孫位高逸圖」五字，歷經北宋內府至清內府流傳有序，是極少數有確實作者可考的唐代人物畫。畫中人物以簡潔線條與素雅著色刻畫，展現名士風骨，是研究唐代人物畫與魏晉風度的珍貴實物.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 《桃源仙境圖》為明代畫家仇英代表作，以陶淵明《桃花源記》為靈感，描繪三位白衣高士臨水而坐、撫琴靜聽的世外景象。畫作採用北宋全景式山水構圖，以石青、石綠為主色，採用工筆重彩技法，樓閣飛簷細筆勾勒，雲氣淡墨渲染，體現青綠山水的成熟技法。此畫原為蘇州名士陳官收藏，後經安岐《墨緣匯觀》著錄，現藏於天津博物館，是仇英集前人之大成、展現文人理想精神家園的傳世名作.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 白釉綠彩三系罐於1971年河南安陽范粹墓出土，屬北齊時期文物，高12.5厘米，造型端莊典雅，腹部飾有覆蓮紋，肩部有三系。此罐以高嶺土製胎，施透明鉛釉，釉色接近白色，並在口沿與肩頸處以翠綠色彩釉點綴，是中國陶瓷史上早期彩釉的珍貴實例。它反映北齊時期，陶瓷工藝從單色釉向多色釉演進的發展里程，為隋唐白瓷與唐三彩的出現奠定技術基礎，是研究中國陶瓷發展史的重要實物.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.sub-title: 汝窯天藍釉刻花鵝頸瓶
programme.desc: 汝窯天藍釉刻花鵝頸瓶為北宋汝窯精品，高19.5厘米，侈口細長頸，圓腹曲線流暢，瓶身施天藍釉，釉層均勻瑩潤，釉下暗刻纏枝蓮花紋，體現「似玉、非玉、而勝玉」的極致美學。汝窯以瑪瑙入釉，為北宋宮廷御窯，燒造時間短暫，傳世極少。此瓶於1987年河南寶豐清涼寺考古發掘出土，是迄今唯一一件具刻花裝飾的天藍釉汝瓷，反映宋代崇尚素雅、道法自然的審美精神，被譽為陶瓷史上的無價之寶.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 《文姬歸漢圖》為金代畫家張瑀之作，描繪東漢才女蔡文姬從匈奴歸返中原的場景。畫中蔡文姬身形挺拔，騎黑馬前行，與隨從縮頸掩袖之態形成對比。畫中細節含蓄表達文姬與親子訣別之痛，以及對故土的不渝歸心。張瑀將金代服飾融入漢代故事，體現北方民族對中原文化的借鑑與融合。此畫曾歷經劫難，及後正式入藏吉林省博物院，是金代人物畫的傳世珍品.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 八曲葵花形螺鈿銅鏡為唐代文物，銅鏡背面以螺鈿工藝鑲嵌貝殼裝飾，內圍飾寶相花，外圍飾展翅鴛鴦，並以綠松石及寶石碎塊點綴，呈現五彩斑斕的視覺效果。此鏡主人為唐高祖李淵第五代孫女李倕，她年僅25歲時因難產去世，此鏡及金冠等珍貴陪葬品出土自其墓葬。唐代銅鏡製作鼎盛，此鏡體現唐代工匠的創新精神與精湛技藝，亦承載中國人「鏡鑒自省」的智慧.

programme.title: 大自然大不同3
programme.desc: Nature is not necessarily ruthless. Some species originally lived together, and two species would bring benefits when they came together. Sometimes it is difficult to survive and reproduce without each other. This relationship is called symbiosis.

programme.title: 守藝薪傳：名家導讀
programme.desc: 本集守藝薪傳名家導賞版，麥勁生教授將介紹中國傳統文化中的舞火龍和客家貔貅。. 舞火龍源自漢代傳統儀式，現於香港大坑和薄扶林村延續。蕭昆崙是薄扶林村的火龍守護者，六十年來，他用竹篾和香火編織火龍，對這項藝術的熱愛不減。他的兒子蕭震南承襲了父親的熱情，兩人攜手開辦工作坊，教授製作迷你火龍的技巧，讓這項傳統在現代社會中重獲新生。. 客家貔貅則是香港傳統文化的一個鮮為人知的故事。資深傳承人鍾浩聲將南鷹爪門白鶴派融入貔貅表演，成立香港獅藝舘，致力推廣客家文化。他的兒子作為第七代傳人，繼續傳承這三百年的藝術，見證香港文化的生命力.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到（英文版）
programme.sub-title: Angel's Life Journey: Accepting the Imperfect Self
programme.desc: For Angel, getting on the upper deck of a double-decker bus and enjoying the scenery along the way is as difficult as climbing Mount Everest. It’s an ordinary wish, but she has spent ten years searching for a way to reach the top. Can she do it?. Angel Leung has muscular dystrophy. Since the age of 26, she has been fighting an uphill battle. Angel is an active person but her days of mobility are numbered. Hoping to leave no regret, she strives for perfection in everything she does, even when she is not in the best physical condition. . Three years ago, Angel became the presenter of this program. She has also been a volunteer in a patient support group. Over these days, she has learnt to accept her imperfect self. She has started to enjoy the process more.

programme.title: 綠惜見未來
programme.desc: Zero Emission. The government has been actively promoting green transportation and has implemented a series of measures to reduce carbon emissions in the transport sector, such as offering tax incentives for electric vehicles, formulating the Strategy of Hydrogen Development in Hong Kong, launching the New Energy Transport Fund, and introducing the Electric Mobility Devices Trial Set. However, the promotion process still faces challenges, including insufficient charging facilities, higher costs, and limitations in technology and infrastructure. . Few years ago, the government unveiled the Hong Kong Climate Action Plan 2050, aiming to achieve zero vehicle emissions and a carbon-neutral transport sector by 2050 through measures such as promoting vehicle electrification and developing new energy transport solutions. Currently, greenhouse gas emissions from transportation remain the second-largest source, accounting for nearly 20% of Hong Kong's total emissions. Is achieving zero vehicle emissions by 2050 an impossible mission.

programme.title: 香港故事：邊境人家
programme.desc: 位於香港東北，鄰近深圳鹽田港，有一個不足50人居住的島，這個島叫作「吉澳」。曾經，吉澳有超過5000人居住，但隨著城市經濟發展及沙頭角被列為禁區，不少村民都搬出市區生活，甚至到海外工作。但離散者總被心中濃厚的鄉情牽引，總惦掛家鄉一事一物，更合力籌款資助於天后宮旁興建「吉澳故事館」。. 而「天后誕」可謂吉澳人心中重要節日，每年除了有島外村民返鄉共慶，旅居僑民亦會跨越數萬里回鄉，共享盛事。數位來自客家村、漁民村的村長，每年都與島上村民合作，即使各位村民早已步入遲暮之年，但仍盡心盡力籌辦節慶，期望一眾鄉俚延續傳統習俗，包括子時拜天后、天后出巡、搶花炮等。不過，最重要的是能夠藉此機會聚首一堂，重拾兒時快樂回憶，繼續「水陸一家親」。. 慶典後島嶼復歸寧靜，但在一眾吉澳人心目中早已期待明年舉辦的十年一度「安龍清醮」，再次回到小島，回味童年的節慶盛事.

programme.title: 看神州
programme.sub-title: 學者：中美元首八點成果共識為全球治理作出貢獻
programme.desc: 國家主席習近平早前完成國事訪美行程，與美國總統特朗普達成八點成果共識，雙方同意構建「基於尊重、公平、對等的中美建設性戰略穩定關係」。中文大學公共政策研究中心副主任孫晉認為，對雙邊關係和貢獻全球治理都非常重要。兩國元首又認可經貿磋商機制積極作用和雙方經貿團隊磋商成果，包括建立並推進貿易理事會等機制。孫晉表示，這是兩國十年來未有過的巨大成就。. 今年是中華人民共和國成立77周年，適逢國家「十五五」開局之年，天安門廣場巨型花籃選用了15種花卉和5種水果造型，連同長安街沿線布置的10組立體花壇，吸引市民遊客爭相打卡。. 電動單車在內地越來越普及，雖然國家已實施強制標準限制其車速和電池電壓，但仍有人非法破解限速設定，執法部門加強打擊。. 神州萬象介紹陝西興起的「菲林相」熱潮，以及四川成都高速公路設立「寵物驛站」.

programme.sub-title: 「娛樂」陷阱 | 當夾公仔變成賭博 玩家或要負刑責?
programme.desc: 夾公仔機是「娛樂」還是「陷阱」? 夾公仔機、彈珠機店等近年在香港遍地開花，相關消費投訴升幅顯著，部分店舖更引入擲骰及抽獎等不同玩法。有法律界人士認為，骰仔已能推定為賭博工具，不只經營者，玩家都有機會要負上刑責。 目前這些娛樂場所並不符合《公眾娛樂場所條例》中「娛樂」的定義，難以監管。為此，政府計劃修例以釐清業界責任，到底規管方向是否對症下藥？ 有人當夾公仔是娛樂，但亦有人為此沉迷上癮，有玩家更承認夾公仔用盡積蓄。當娛樂變成陷阱，責任誰屬呢? 想睇更多: https://www.rthk.hk/tv/dtt31/programme/hkcc/ 逢星期四/ 晚上9時30 / 港台電視31 立即下載「香港電台隨身版(RTHK On The Go)」緊貼最新節目: https://rthk.hk/otg 記得LIKE + 訂閱 + 推播通知! #彈珠機店 #夾公仔機 #娛樂 #陷阱 #公眾娛樂場所條例 #有獎娛樂場所條例 #當夾公仔變成賭博 #玩家或要負刑責.

programme.title: 廣東話去旅行 -- 土耳其篇 (英文版)
programme.desc: Cappadocia is a must-visit spot for any traveller in Turkey, bursting with dreamlike scenery and a touch of romance. . Vicky and Meka finally fulfil their wish of riding in a hot air balloon, drifting through the sky to take in the magical landscape of Cappadocia’s “fairy chimneys”. Millions of years ago, volcanic eruptions buried this region in ash, and, over time, wind and erosion sculpted layers of canyons and caves. People cleverly carved fortresses into the rocks for defence, and built underground cities for safety—leaving behind the moving stories of Christians hiding to escape persecution. . The name “Cappadocia” comes from the Persian “Katpatuka”, meaning “the land of beautiful horses”. Embracing local traditions, Vicky and Meka ride gentle horses through the valleys, brushing past cave churches and ending their adventure on a dreamy note as the sun sets.

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第六集 - 鄭衍峰、周卓盈、黃明德｜千年智慧九連環誰能拆解？
programme.desc: 本季最後一集有星級嘉賓藝人鄭衍峰、體育舞蹈員周卓盈Tracy和歌手黃明德Dark。三位對不同類別的中華文化都有所認識，漢代發明、唐代官制、經典文學、新疆基建、地理知識的問題，他們又能否逐一解答？想不到安徽黃山宏村馬頭牆的功能竟會難倒一眾嘉賓！而互動題為大家帶來由古代時興至今的益智玩具「九連環」，設計巧妙、又蘊藏數學原理，要拆解更加考起手腦配合！最後誰夠心靈手巧，再憑豐富知識，贏得最後一集的中華知識王令牌呢？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：鄭衍峰、周卓盈、黃明德. #中華知識王2#曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#鄭衍峰#周卓盈#黃明德#安徽黃山#宏村馬頭牆#九連環#紅樓夢.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂 (英文版)
programme.desc: This episode takes audiences beyond traditional regional divides to uncover the authentic hometown flavors of Hanoi hidden right here in Hong Kong. . Owners Kenny and Julie pour their hearts into their cozy eatery. Every week, they personally air-freight fresh ingredients—and even hand-carry traditional Vietnamese decor back in their luggage—all to faithfully recreate the most authentic Northern Vietnamese dining experience, featuring specialties like Hanoi-style beef tenderloin pho and delicate rice paper rolls. . Though they rely on zero aggressive marketing campaigns, their dedication has inspired loyal regulars to spontaneously write articles and produce videos celebrating the restaurant, with local jewelry brands even reaching out for creative collaborations. Behind every steaming bowl of noodle soup lies the owners' unwavering commitment to authentic Vietnamese flavors—and the heartfelt, enduring bonds they have forged with their diners along the way.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: 位於元朗工業區內，一間行業領先的大型洗衣公司與社福機構合作，將後勤工作轉化為殘疾人士發揮所長的機會。這項計劃不僅解決了人力需求、提升服務品質，更為員工帶來工作的尊嚴與成就感。. 其中，元老級員工豪哥自十七歲加入至今，從學員成長為工廠中備受信賴的骨幹。部門經理玉姐以耐心指導，協助殘疾員工在工作中學習與成長。洗衣公司深信，能獲得「Inclusive Buddy Award」有賴全體同事的支持與包容，正是這種文化讓豪哥與許多後勤員工找到自我價值。. 另一方面，香港科技產業中，軟件測試崗位重複性高且需技術知識，需反覆檢驗程式碼與介面。一間本地科技公司與社企合作，為自閉症譜系青年提供就業機會，發現他們的特質——高度專注與堅持——正是此崗位所需的優勢。當特質轉化為專業能力，職場的可能性遠超想象。. 兩間企業皆證明：敞開胸懷提供機會，所獲得的遠比預期更多.

programme.title: 煮題COOK
